reason: Document is only a bill-history page giving the petition title; it does not state what the eviction protections would require (rule 6). It also authorizes rather than limits eviction causes, and the bill was sent to a study order, not struck.

rule.title: Boston tenant eviction protections home rule petition (not enacted)
rule.requirement: This bill would have let Boston adopt eviction protections for tenants. It was sent to a study order in 2024 and did not become law.
rule.requirement_es: Este proyecto de ley habría permitido a Boston adoptar protecciones contra el desalojo para inquilinos. Fue enviado a una orden de estudio en 2024 y no se convirtió en ley.
rule.coverage_text: Proposed home rule petition for the City of Boston; it was sent to a study order and not enacted.
rule.quote: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
